in_hebrew.name: Gerhan
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Ruler of the man
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Gerhan הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek name Geron, meaning 'ruler' or 'elder'. In Christian tradition, this name symbolizes leadership, wisdom, and respect for the elderly.

in_greek.name: Gerhan
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Ruler of the man
in_greek.long_meaning: Gerhan είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Greek name Geron, meaning 'ruler' or 'elder'. In Christian tradition, this name symbolizes leadership, wisdom, and respect for the elderly.

in_latin.name: Gerhan
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Ruler of the man
in_latin.long_meaning: Gerhan est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Greek name Geron, meaning 'ruler' or 'elder'. In Christian tradition, this name symbolizes leadership, wisdom, and respect for the elderly.
